t: Terry's Theatre once stood here on the Strand, though it no longer exists. It was built in 1887 as a West End theatre, became a cinema in 1910, and was demolished in 1923. The actor Edward O'Connor Terry, who lived from 1844 to 1912, owned it. The architect Walter Emden designed it. Emden was one of the leading English theatre and music hall architects during the building boom between 1885 and 1915.
